grade1-count-120.title: The Big Button Count
grade1-count-120.tagline: Count a giant class collection by tens and ones, all the way past 100.
grade1-count-120.description: Students count a large class collection of buttons (or other small objects). They group by tens, count on past 100, write the numbers, and count on or back to show what happens when buttons are added or taken.

grade1-add-subtract-10.title: Ten Frame Bakery
grade1-add-subtract-10.tagline: Bake, sell and box muffins in trays of ten.
grade1-add-subtract-10.description: Students run a pretend bakery whose muffin trays are ten frames. They add and subtract within 10, find the partner that makes 10, and write order cards.

grade1-add-subtract-20.title: Bean Bag Toss Champions
grade1-add-subtract-20.tagline: Play a bean bag toss and add the scores within 20.
grade1-add-subtract-20.description: Students play a bean bag toss with point zones from 1 to 9. They add scores within 20 with make-a-ten and doubles, add three tosses, and use related facts to find missing scores.

grade1-equal-sign.title: Balance Scale Puzzles
grade1-equal-sign.tagline: Use a pan balance to make both sides the same.
grade1-equal-sign.description: Students use a pan balance (or a drawn one) with cubes to test equations. They decide whether equations are true or false and find the missing number that balances both sides, then make a puzzle book.

grade1-word-problems-20.title: Farm Story Problems
grade1-word-problems-20.tagline: Write and solve story problems about animals on a farm.
grade1-word-problems-20.description: Students visit a pretend farm and solve add to, take from, put together, take apart and compare stories within 20, including stories with an unknown start and three numbers. They write a class story book.

grade1-tens-ones.title: Pencil Packing Factory
grade1-tens-ones.tagline: Pack pencils into boxes of ten and count the shipment.
grade1-tens-ones.description: Students run a pretend factory that packs pencils (or straws) in boxes of ten. They bundle ones into tens, show teen numbers, count by tens and write two-digit numbers as tens and ones on a packing report.

grade1-compare-numbers.title: Number Card Showdown
grade1-compare-numbers.tagline: Build two-digit numbers from cards and compare them with >, = and <.
grade1-compare-numbers.description: Students play a card game: each player builds a two-digit number from digit cards and compares it with a partner's number using >, = and <. They record each round and reason about the best numbers to build.

grade1-add-subtract-100.title: Class Garden Seeds
grade1-add-subtract-100.tagline: Plan a class garden with seed packs of ten.
grade1-add-subtract-100.description: Students plan a class garden. Seeds come in packs of 10. They find 10 more and 10 less, add and subtract tens, add a one-digit number to a two-digit number, and make a new ten when the ones add to 10 or more.

grade1-measuring-length.title: Paper Zoo Line-Up
grade1-measuring-length.tagline: Measure paper zoo animals with cubes and put them in order.
grade1-measuring-length.description: Students make or use paper animals (snake, giraffe, crocodile, worm). They compare and order lengths, compare two animals using a piece of string, and measure each animal with same-size cubes laid end to end.

grade1-telling-time.title: My School Day Clock Book
grade1-telling-time.tagline: Make a clock book of the school day to the hour and half hour.
grade1-telling-time.description: Students make a clock book of a school day. They read and draw analog clocks to the hour and half hour, write the matching digital times, and find what time it will be one hour or half an hour later.

grade1-data.title: Our Class Survey
grade1-data.tagline: Ask a question, tally the answers and make a picture graph.
grade1-data.description: Students ask the class a survey question with three choices. They tally the answers, make a picture graph, and answer questions about how many in all and how many more or fewer.

grade1-shapes-equal-shares.title: Shape Pizza Party
grade1-shapes-equal-shares.tagline: Build pictures with shapes and share pizzas in halves and fourths.
grade1-shapes-equal-shares.description: Students plan a pizza party. They sort shapes by their attributes, build a picture from pattern blocks, and cut round and rectangle pizzas into halves and fourths to share fairly.
